senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Who or what has or holds.
m. (-रः)
1 A mountain.
2 A flock of cotton.
3 The tortoise Avatāra.
4 One of the demigods called VASUS.
f. (-रा)
1 The earth.
2 The uterus or womb.
3 Marrow.
4 A vessel of the body.
5 A golden globe or heap of valuables, representing the earth, and given to Brahmans.
E.
धृञ् to have or hold, to contain or support, &c. affix अच्, or ट fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.

n. (-रं)
Water derived from rain.
m. (-रः)
1 A sort of stone.
2 Debt.
3 Slight sprinkling rain.
4 Frost.
5 End, bound, a line or limit.
6 A deep place, a depth.
f. (-रा)
1 A horse's pace, as the trot, canter, &c.
2 The van of an army.
3 The sharp edge of a sword or any cutting instrument.
4 The flowing, running, oozing, or distilling, &c. of any liquid, the motion of a fluid, stream, current, &c.
5 Offspring.
6 A leak, a flaw, a hole in a pitcher, &c.
7 Excellence.
8 The wheel of a carriage.
9 A garden wall or fence, a hedge, &c.
10 The edge of a mountain.
11 Quantity, multitude.
12 A heavy shower falling in large drops, or hail.
13 Fame.
14 Likeness.
15 Custom, usage.
16 The capital of BHOJA.
17 Pouring a stream of water upon an image to get rid of a fever.
E.
धृ to fall, to uphold, &c. in the causal form, and अङ् and टाप् affs.

mn. (-णः-णं)
1 Holding, possessing, having.
2 A sort of measure, a weight of ten Palas.
3 A weight of silver, sixteen Māṣas.
m. (-णः)
1 The Himāla mountain considered as king of mountains.
2 The sun.
3 A world.
4 A breast, a female breast.
5 Rice.
6 A ridge of land answering the purpose of a bridge, the edge of a river, the skirt of a mountain, a bridge.
f. (-णी)
1 The earth.
2 The silk cotton tree.
3 A vessel of the body.
4 An esculent root.
E.
धृ to hold, to uphold or support, affix ल्युट्, fem. affix ङीप्.

n. (-णं)
Holding, having, keeping, maintaining.
f. (-णा)
1 Continuance in rectitude, keeping in the right way.
2 Fortitude, firmness, steadiness, resolution.
3 A particular religious exercise; keeping the mind collected, the breath suspended, and all natural wants restrained; steady, immoveable abstraction.
4 Mental retention, memory.
5 Understanding, intellect.
6 Believing, conviction.
7 Certainty, conclusion.
8 Positive precept or injunction.
9 Debt.
f. (-णी)
1 Any tubular vessel of the body.
2 A mystical verse or charm, or collection of such verses, among the Bauddhas.
3 A row or line.
E.
धृ to hold, (purpose, intent, virtue, &c.) affix ल्युट् or युच्.

f. (-णिः)
The earth.
E.
धृ to be contained, (animals, &c.) Uṇādi affix अणि; also धरणी as above.

m. (-रः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
धरणि the earth, and धर who sustains; also धरणिधर.

m. (-रः)
1 VIṢṆU.
2 A mountain.
3 A tortoise: see धरणिधर.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Being or staying on earth.
E.
धरणि, and स्थ what stays or is.

m. (-न्दः)
An esculent root or bulb.
E.
धरणी the earth, कन्द a root.

m. (-कः)
A mountain.
E.
धरणी the earth, कीलक a pin or bolt.

m. (-रः)
The ocean.
E.
धरणी the earth, पूर to surround completely, affix अच्.

m. (-वः)
The ocean.
E.
धरणी the earth, and प्लव what swims; in which the earth floats.

m. (-रः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
धरणी, and ईश्वर lord; lord of the world.

f. (-ता)
A name of SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA.
E.
धरणी the earth, and सुता daughter; the earth-born; being turned up from the soil by a plough, as JANAKA was ploughing a spot to prepare it for a sacrifice.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Like a mountain, as huge as, &c.
E.
धर, and संस्थ what is, or is like.

m. (-म्बः)
The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba); also धराकदम्बक.

m. (-जः)
The planet Mars or its regent.
E.
धरा the earth, and आत्मज son, terræ-filius; also similar compounds, as धरासुत, धरापुत्र, &c.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU.
2 A mountain.
E.
धरा the earth, and धर who or what sustains.

m. (-रः)
1 A cloud.
2 A sword.
E.
धारा rain or an edge, and धर what has.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sleeping on the ground.
E.
धरा, and शय who sleeps.

m. (-रः)
A Brahman.
E.
धरा, and अमर a deity.

f. (-त्री)
The earth.
E.
धृ to contain, (beings,) इत्र Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीप्.

m. (-मा)
1 Form, figure, semblance.
2 A balance, a pair of scales.
E.
धृ to have or hold, Uṇādi affix इमनिच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Measurable by weight.
E.
धरिम, and मेय to be measured.

m. (-णः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 Heaven, paradise.
3 Water.
4 Opinion, conception.
E.
धृ to hold or uphold, affix उनन्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be upheld or supported.
2 To be had or possessed.
3 To be placed or fixed.
4 To be fallen or alighted by.
E.
धृ to hold, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ)
Who or what has or holds.
E.
धृ to have, तृन् aff.

n. (-र्त्त्रं)
1 A house.
2 Sacrifice.
3 Virtue, moral merit.
E.
धृ to contain, Uṇādi affix त्र.

mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं)
1 Virtue, moral and religious merit, according to the law and the Vedas.
2 Usage, practice, the customary observances of caste, sect, &c.
3 Duty, especially that enjoined by the Vedas.
4 Fitness, propriety.
5 Nature, character, proper or natural state or disposition.
6 Innocence, innoxiousness.
7 Resemblance.
8 Any sacrifice.
9 An Upaniṣad or theological portion of a Veda.
10 Any peculiar or prescribed practice or duty; thus, giving, alms, &c. is the dharma of a householder; administering justice, the dharma of a king; piety, that of a Brahman; courage, that of a Kṣatriya, &c.
11 Kind and virtuous speech or discourse.
12 Law.
m. (-र्म्मः)
1 A name of YAMA, ruler of the lower regions, and judge of the dead.
2 A drinker of the juice of the acid asclepias, at certain sacrifices.
3 Virtue personified, born from the right breast of BRAHMĀ.
4 A bow.
5 Associating with the virtuous.
6 The fifteenth of the twenty-four Jaina pontiffs of the present age.
7 A pious or virtuous man.
8 The bull of ŚIVA, a personification or type of virtue.
E.
धृ to maintain or support, &c. Uṇādi affix मन्, what supports all men.

n. (-र्म्म)
Acting according to some or any indispensable act of piety or duty.
E.
धर्म्म, and कर्म्मन् act.

m. (-यः)
A Jina or Jaina deified saint.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, and काय body; virtue personified.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Any indispensable act of religion, &c.
2 Religious or virtuous conduct.
E.
धर्म्म piety, and कार्य्य act.

m. (-लः)
An edict, a royal order, decree, or grant.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, कील proper stay; also with कन् added, धर्म्मकीलक m. (-कः)

n. (-त्यं)
Any moral or religious observance.
E.
धर्म्म, and कृत्य to be done.

m. (-तुः)
A Jaina deified saint.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, केत् an emblem or banner.

m. (-षः)
Store or treasure of virtue.
E.
धर्म्म, and कोष treasury.

f. (-या)
1 Righteous conduct, acting according to law.
2 Any religious act.
E.
धर्म्म, and क्रिया act.

n. (-त्रं)
A plain in the north-west of India near Delhi, the scene of the great battle between the Kurus and Pāṇḍus.
m. (-त्रः)
A man of piety and virtue.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, holiness, and क्षेत्र a field, literally or figuratively.

n. (-णं)
Observance of moral or religious institutes, accepting or following the law.
E.
धर्म्म, and ग्रहण taking.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Immoral, unlawful, contrary to law or duty.
E.
धर्म्म, and घ्न what destroys.

m. (-क्रः)
A Jaina deified saint.
E.
धर्म्म, and चक्र a wheel, &c.

m. (-त्)
A Jaina deified saint.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, चक्र a circle, and भृत् possessing.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Virtuous, moral, dutiful.
f. (-रिणी)
A virtuous woman, an honest wife.
E.
धर्म्म duty, चर to follow, affix णिनि and ङीष्.

n. (-नं)
Virtuous reflection.
E.
धर्म्म, and चिन्तन reflecting.

f. (-न्ता)
Virtuous reflection.
E.
धर्म्म, and चिन्ता reflection: see the last.

m. (-नः)
A Brahman who lives according to rule, one who practices the outward acts of the law.
E.
धर्म्म, and जीवन living.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Knowing one's duty, conversant with virtue.
E.
धर्म्म, and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-नं)
Knowledge of moral, legal, and religious duty.
E.
धर्म्म, and ज्ञान knowledge.

m. (-णः)
1 A sort of tree, commonly Dhāminiya.
2 A kind of large snake, not poisonous, commonly Dhemana.

ind.
Rightly, justly, righteously.
E.
धर्म्म, and तसि aff.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Morality, piety.
2 Inherent nature, peculiar property, &c.
E.
धर्म्म, and त्व aff.

f. (-वी)
The Ganges.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, द्रु to shed, affix अच्.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Wicked.
(-ही)
A Rākṣasa.
E.
धर्म्म, and द्रोहिन् rebellious.

m. (-तुः)
A Jaina saint.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, धातु essence, root.

m. (-जी)
A religious hypocrite or impostor, one who makes a livelihood by assumed devotion.
E.
धर्म्म piety, ध्वज an emblem, इनि affix; having every outward mark of piety, matted hair, ragged garments, &c.

m. (-न्धः)
Piety, virtue.
E.
धर्म्म, and निबन्ध attachment.

mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि)
Pious, holy, engaged in or conducive to virtue.
E.
धर्म्म, निबन्ध connexion, and इनि aff.

f. (-त्तिः)
Duty, moral or religious observance, discharge or fulfilment of duty.
E.
धर्म्म, and निष्पत्ति completion.

n. (-नं)
1 Pepper.
2 The name of a district or city.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, पत्तन a city; pepper grows there, whence is said to be its name.

f. (-त्नी)
A man's first wife and of the same class.
E.
धर्म्म, and पत्नी a wife.

n. (-त्रं)
Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.)
E.
धर्म्म sacrifice, and पत्र leaf.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Righteous, pious.
E.
धर्म्म, and पर addicted to.

m. (-कः)
A teacher of law.
E.
धर्म्म, and पाठक who teaches.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 A name of the Pāṇḍu prince, YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
2 One so considered, as a son for piety or duty; also धर्म्मपुत्त्रक.
E.
धर्म्म a proper name, and पुत्त्र a son, the son of DHARMA or YAMA.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Eminent in piety.
E.
धर्म्म, and प्रधान chief.

m. (-क्ता)
A teacher or expounder of the law.
E.
धर्म्म, and प्रवक्तृ who explains.

f. (-नी)
A virtuous and amiable wife.
E.
धर्म्म, and भागिनी who shares.

m. (-कः)
A lecturer, a public reader of the Mahābhārata and other sacred works which are read aloud, and explained to large assemblies of Hindūs at particular seasons.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, and भण to utter, to speak, affix ण्वुल्.

m. (-ता)
A fellow religious student.
E.
धर्म्म, and भ्रातृ a brother.

m. (-कः)
A mendicant Brahman, one who is so, or has become so from meritorious motives.
E.
धर्म्म, and भिक्षुक a beggar.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Moral, righteous, made up or replete with virtue, &c.
E.
धर्म्म, and मयट् aff.

n. (-लं)
The foundation of Hindū law and religion (the Vedas.)
E.
धर्म्म, and मूल root.

mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
Virtuous, righteous.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, यु to go, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-युक्)
Righteous, pious, just.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, युज to join, affix क्विप्.

m. (-जः)
1 A Jina or deified saint, according to the Jaina sect.
2 A name of YAMA, regent of the dead.
3 A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
4 Also of ARJUNA.
5 A king in general.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, justice, and राज who shines, affix अच्; or राज from राजन a king; lord of justice.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
Illegal, immoral.
E.
धर्म्म, and रोधिन् opposed to.

n. (-णं)
An essential ingredient in ethics^1 or law, (as place, time, &c.)
E.
धर्म्म, and लक्षण mark.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-बत्)
Virtuous, pious, upright, just.
E.
धर्म्मं as above, मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-रः)
The day of full moon.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, and वासर a day; peculiar sacrifices being performed on this day.

m. (-नः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
धर्म्म the bull of this god, virtue typified, and वाहन a vehicle.

mfn. (-द् or -त्)
1 Virtuous, pious, moral.
2 Acquainted with the law.
E.
धर्म्म, and विद् who knows.

f. (-धिः)
Course of law, legal precepts or injunctions.
E.
धर्म्म, and विधि manner.

m. (-वः)
Immorality, wickedness.
E.
धर्म्म, and विप्लव submersion.

n. (-नं)
Judicial investigation.
E.
धर्म्म, and विवेचन deliberation.

f. (-ला)
A court of justice, a tribunal.
E.
धर्म्म justice, and शाला a hall.

n. (-स्त्वं)
1 The body or code of Hindu law.
2 Any work on the subject.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, and शास्र a treatise.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Virtuous, just, pious.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, शील attached to.

f. (-ता)
A code of laws, especially the work of some saint or divine person, as MANU, YĀJÑAVALKYA, &c.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, and सम् prefixed to धा, to have or possess, affix क्त, fem. affix टाप्; a compilation made for the purpose of teaching and maintaining virtue.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Virtue.
2 Hypocrisy.
E.
धर्म्म, and सङ्ग addiction to, real or seeming.

mfn. (-सूः-सूः-सू)
Virtuous, producing virtuous offspring or actions.
E.
धर्म्म, सन्तान progeny, सू who bears.

f. (-भा)
A tribunal, a court of justice.
E.
धर्म्म justice, and सभा assembly.

n. (-नं)
Any act or virtue essential to a system of duties.
E.
धर्म्म, and साधन instrument.

m. (-र्णिः)
The eleventh MANU.

m. (-तः)
A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
E.
धर्म्म YAMA, and सुत a son; also धर्म्मसूनु, धर्म्मात्मज, &c.

m. (-त्मा)
A saint, a pious or virtuous person.
E.
घर्म्म virtue, आत्मन् self.

f. (-क्षा)
Ordeal by drawing lots or slips of black and white paper.
E.
धर्म्म, अधर्म्म iniquity, परीक्षा trial.

n. (-णं)
A court of justice.
m. (-णः)
A judge.
E.
धर्म्म, and अधिकरण supervision.

m. (-णी)
A judge, a sovereign, an administrator of the law.
E.
धर्म्माधिकरण, and affix इनि.

m. (-रः)
The office of a judge.
E.
धर्म्म, and अधिकार office.

m. (-री)
A judge.
E.
धर्म्माधिकार, and इनि aff.

m. (-क्षः)
A magistrate, a judge, &c.
E.
धर्म्म justice, and अध्यक्ष superintendent.

n. (-नं)
Virtuous or moral conduct, behaviour according to law.
E.
धर्म्म, and अनुष्ठान act or condition.

m. (-रः)
Conformity to law or virtue, course or practice of duty.
E.
धर्म्म, and अनुसार following.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wicked, immoral, unrighteous.
n. (-तं)
Immorality, vice.
E.
धर्म्म, and अपेत deviated.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Virtuous.
E.
धर्म्म, अभि to or inclined to, मनस् the mind.

n. (-ण्यं)
A forest into which DHARMA once retired.
E.
धर्म्म, and अरण्य a wood.

n. (-नं)
The seat of the judge, the bench.
E.
धर्म्मं, and आसन a seat.

mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि)
1 Virtuous, pious, just.
2 Endowed with a peculiar property or faculty.
E.
धर्म्म, and इनि poss. aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very pious or virtuous.
E.
धर्म्म, and इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very pious, moral, &c.
E.
धर्म्म, and ईयसुन् aff.

m. (-शः)
Moral or religious instruction.
E.
धर्म्म, and उपदेश advice.

m. (-कः)
A Guru or spiritual preceptor.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, उप before दिश to show, affix वुन्; pointing out good and evil to his scholars.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Hypocritical.
E.
धर्म्म, and उपधि fraud, अच aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Virtuous, moral.
E.
धर्म्म, and उपेत possessed of.

mfn. (-र्म्म्यः-र्म्म्या-र्म्मां)
1 Conformable or according to justice or morality.
2 Obtainable by virtue or justice.
E.
धर्म्म as above, यत् aff.

m. (-हः)
Legal marriage of five sorts, as the Brāhma, Daiva, Ārṣa, Gandharba, and Prājāpatya.
E.
धर्म्मा, and विवाह marriage.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Pride, arrogance.
2 Contumely, overbearing.
3 Impatience.
4 Paralysing, rendering weak or impotent.
5 Injury, wrong.
6 Restraint.
7 Copulation.
8 A eunuch.
E.
धृष to be vain, affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
A dancer, an actor, a mime.
E.
धृष to be vain or presumptuous, affix वुन्.

f. (-णी)
A violated virgin.
E.
धर्ष, कृ to act, affix णिनि.

n. (-णं)
1 Disrespect, contumely, overbearingness or contempt.
2 Copulation.
3 Arrogance, vanity.
f. (-णिः-णी)
An unchaste woman.
E.
धृष to be arrogant, &c. affix ल्युट्.

m. (-रः)
A eunuch superintending the women's apartments.
E.
धर्ष copulation, वृ to cherish, affix अप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Proud, insolent.
2 Unbearing, impatient.
3 Overpowered, smitten.
n. (-तं)
Copulation, cohabitation.
2 Contumely.
3 Pride.
f. (-ता)
An unchaste woman.
E.
धृष to be vain or impatient, affix क्त.

mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि)
1 Proud, arrogant.
2 Cohabiting.
f. (-णी)
A dishonest or unchaste woman.
E.
धर्ष cohabitation, इनि and ङीष् affs.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what holds or contains, a vessel or receptacle of any kind.
m. (-कः)
A water pot.
E.
धृ to have, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-कः)
A debtor.
E.
धारण a debt, कन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be held or retained, to be adhered to.
E.
धृ to hold, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Who or what has or possesses.
E.
धृ to have, causal form, श aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
1 Having, possessing.
2 Acquainted with, versed in.
3 Holding as doctrine, believing, maintaining.
E.
धृ to have, शतृ aff.

f. (-त्री)
The earth.
E.
धृ to contain, in the causal form, तृच् aff.

m. (-कः)
A sort of Kadamba tree.

m. (-रः)
1 Thin rain.
2 Hail.
3 Advancing before an army by way of defiance to an enemy.
E.
धारा rain, and अङ्कुर shoot or sprout.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A sword, a scimitar.
2 A place of pilgrimage.
E.
धारा the edge of a sword, &c. and अङ्ग body.

m. (-टः)
1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
2 A horse.
3 A cloud.
4 A furious elephant.
E.
धारा rain, &c. अट who goes.

f. (-निः)
The sound of falling rain or of the flowing of any fluid.
E.
धारा, and ध्वनि sound.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A scent bottle, a sprinkling vase or ewer, a sort of censer.
E.
धारा, and यन्त्र an instrument.

m. (-निः)
Air, wind.
E.
धारा thin rain, वन to sound, affix इ.

m. (-षः)
A crooked sword, a scimitar, a sabre.
E.
धारा, and विष poison; whose edge is as fatal as venom.

n. (-श्रु)
A flood of tears.
E.
धारा, and अश्रु a tear.

m. (-तः)
A hard shower, a heavy fall of rain.
E.
धारा rain, सम् implying quantity or accumulation, and पात falling.

m. (-रः)
A heavy fall of rain, a large drop or shower.
E.
धारा, and आसार sprinkling.

f. (-णी)
1 The earth.
2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
E.
धृ, and घिणुन् aff.

n. (-तं)
A horse's trot; also धारितकंः see धौरितकं.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Having, holding, keeping, possessing.
2 Edged.
m. (-री)
A sort of tree: see पीलु.
E.
धारा an edge, &c. इनि aff.

mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु)
Who drinks or sucks, a drinker, a sucker.
E.
धे to drink, रु affix, form special.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
1 A sort of goose, with black legs and bill.
2 A kind of snake.
3 DURYODHANA or any other descendant of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
धृतराष्ट्र the name of a king or a bird, &c. and अण् affix of descent.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Virtuous, pious, just.
E.
धर्म्म virtue, affix ठञ्.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
1 To be born or upheld, to be contained, &c.
2 To be kept or detained.
3 To be determined.
E.
धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being held, maintained, &c.
E.
धृ to uphold, pass. v., शानच् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Property.
E.
त्व added to the last.

n. (-र्ष्ट्यं)
Boldness, confidence, arrogance.
E.
धृष्टि bold, and ष्यञ् aff.
